Are opposition voices or civil society organizations being given space to report on campaign activities, or is this announcement controlled through friendly media outlets?

Which specific diseases beyond Lassa fever are covered by this fund, and was there stakeholder consultation with health workers and communities most affected by these diseases?

articles.title: Ex-PDP spokesperson canvasses stiffer penalties for fake drugs, adulterated goods producers
articles.summary:

articles.hausa_translation: Tsohon mai magana na PDP yana bukatar azabtar da hukunci don waɗanda ke yin ƙarfi kariya da kayayyaki masu ƙazantarwa. Olisa Metuh ya ba da shawarar ƙarin lokaci a kurkuku da kamen kasuwa ga duk wanda aka sani ya yin ko ya rarraba kayayyaki masu ƙarfi kariya.

Why highlight Metuh's party affiliation if this is a non-partisan public health issue—does his political standing lend credibility or suggest a political agenda?
What voices are absent: input from small-scale producers, informal sector workers, or those who might be disproportionately affected by asset forfeiture?

articles.title: Sowore, Ekiti police give conflicting accounts of alleged attack on AAC presidential candidate

articles.hausa_translation: Sowore, 'yan sanda Ekiti suna ba da sanarwa masu bambanci game da watsewatsen bugi a kan 'yar takarar shugaban kasa AAC. Alhali Sowore ya bayyana abubuwan da ya faru a matsayin bugi a kan jama'arsa, 'yan sanda Ekiti State suka ce abubuwan da ya faru na sakamakon watsewa tsakanin ƙungiya daban-daban.
critical_questions: Who initiated the altercation and what evidence supports each account - video, witness statements, or police reports?

What was Sowore's team doing in Ekiti at this time, and were there prior tensions or organized opposition to their presence?
Has the police released an official incident report, and why are conflicting accounts being given without independent investigation conclusions?

articles.title: Passengers Burnt to death as bus collides with truck In Kwara
articles.summary: At least three passengers were reportedly burnt to death after a bus and a truck collided and caught fire in Ilorin, the Kwara State capital.
